question:

(A) [0.3032, 0.4388, 0.4935, 0.6291]
(B) [0.4064, 0.6903, 0.5967, 0.8806]
(C) [0.7887, 0.3082, 0.9790, 0.4985]
(D) No defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.

Since I have examined all three regions (A, B, and C) and did not find any obvious defects in any of them, the correct answer is D.
